rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 952 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 386, ALSO KNOWN AS THE CIVIL CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Amends Article 952 of the Civil Code of the Philippines, to read as: “The heir [, charged with the legacy or devise] or the executor or administrator of the estate, must deliver the very thing bequeathed if he is liable to do so and cannot discharge this obligation by paying its value.” “Legacy of money must be paid in cash, even though the heir or the estate may not have any.” “ The expenses necessary for the delivery of the thing bequeathed shall be for the account of the heir or the estate, but without prejudice to the legitime.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-27

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO AMEND ARTICLE 18 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 209, ALSO KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Seeks to prevent a situation wherein the solemnizing officer celebrates the marriage even with the existence of an impediment that renders the marriage void.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-27

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE DISCLOSURE OF LOBBYING ACTIVITIES
rows.title_short: Lobbying Accountability Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Lobbying Accountability Act of 2009.” Aims to make lobbying activities public in order to restore the trust and confidence of the people in the government and that openness, honesty, and integrity form as the basis of dealings between Members of Congress and the lobbyists.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06515

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURERS TO PROVIDE FULL COVERAGE FOR THE PREVENTION, EARLY DETECTION, DIAGNOSIS AND TREATMENT OF AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER
rows.title_short: Autism Prevention, Early Detection, Diagnosis And Treatment Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Autism Prevention, Early Detection, Diagnosis and Treatment Act of 2009.” Seeks to provide parents and their children access to treatment by requiring health insurers to provide full coverage not only for treatment but also the prevention, early detection and diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-01-27

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING RESTAURANTS AND OTHER FOOD-SERVICE ESTABLISHMENTS TO CLEARLY DISPLAY CALORIE COUNT LISTINGS OF THE FOOD ITEMS THEY SERVE
rows.title_short: Calorie Count Display Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Calorie Count Display Act of 2009.” Seeks to create a consciousness in the people with regard to the amount of calories they consume from foods in restaurants and other food establishments, by requiring the said restaurants and food establishments to display prominently to customers the calorie count listings of the food items they serve.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2009-01-27

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF EXPLOITIVE CHILD MODELING AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Anti-exploitive Child Modeling Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “Anti-Exploitive Child Modeling Act of 2009.” Seeks to penalize the display of a child's image through any medium, or employ a child in exploitive child modeling, with the intent to make a financial gain, without a direct or indirect purpose of marketing a product or service.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on THE WELFARE OF CHILDREN since 2009-01-27
